as_told.title: Steinman's book and FOIA on the Interplanetary Phenomenon Unit

plain: A researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells podcast host Jesse Michels that an Army unit called the IPU, short for Interplanetary Phenomenon Unit, came to light in 1986 and 1987. According to UAPGerb, researchers such as William Steinman found it by filing requests under FOIA, a US law that lets anyone ask for government records. If true, it would mean the Army once had a unit set up to look into these matters.
